candidates.description: This vector activates for fragments of the Hindi word for "today" (आज) and related Devanagari character sequences.
This feature vector represents subword tokens related to the COVID-19 pandemic and associated coronavirus nomenclature across multiple languages.
This vector represents numerals and numerical digits across different scripts.
This feature vector represents consecutive integers within the twenty-something range.
This vector activates for various consonant-vowel conjuncts and characters from the Devanagari script.
This vector activates on various sub-word tokens and suffixes across multiple Indic and Latin scripts.
These tokens represent common Hindi consonant-vowel matra combinations and conjuncts used in Devanagari script.
This vector activates for common suffixes, inflectional markers, and morphographemic combinations in the Hindi Devanagari script.
This feature vector represents character sequences and subword fragments containing the Hindi letter 'द' (da) and its corresponding vowel combinations.
This feature activates on common Hindi subword tokens, suffixes, and characters, particularly variations containing the nasalized vowel 'in' or 'en' sounds.
